name: oh-no-my-claudecode
description: Repo-native memory for AI coding agents. Builds a structured memory store from git history, extracts architectural decisions and invariants, and surfaces them via CLAUDE.md, Claude Code hooks, and MCP tools (search_memory, guard_task, get_brief).
author: ONMC Contributors

onmc.description: ONMC MCP server — exposes search_memory, guard_task, get_brief, and memory resources to Claude Code mid-session.

hooks.description: Installs PreCompact, SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, and SessionEnd hooks so context survives every compaction and memory stays fresh.

setup.description: Interactive onboarding wizard — reads git history, generates CLAUDE.md, and connects Claude Code hooks and MCP.
